name: Munkie
summary: Run, jump and climb in the new game Munkie! Explore from the deepest depths of the mines to the high peaks of the desert! Equip completely free colours and cosmetics for everyone to wear! Check out our local munkie J.I.M. who is definitely friendly to everyone! Shiver in the Snow Map, or practice your skills in parkour! Search for the secrets, or dive deeper into the Underground! Explore everything this game has to offer!
